take: Pittsburgh announced it has placed centers Ben Kindel and Blake Lizotte, right wing Justin Brazeau and defenseman Ryan Graves on injured reserve. Kindel has played 9 games with 2 goals and 4 points, and his line is outscored slightly with him on the ice. Going by how the coach has used his players, Lizotte (12:38 a night) is next in line for Kindel's minutes, but Lizotte is also hurt, so Hendrix Lapierre is the likeliest to move up. The Penguins are 3-6-1.
